verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs describe post-response scripts for API tests, including writing a basic test to validate the API response, and running those test collections in CI via the Postman CLI or Newman. A community user also calls it invaluable for validating APIs. The evidence never spells out assertions on status codes, body fields and headers individually, so the full story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assertions on response status, body and headers (e.g. assertion syntax or a test library reference), and hands-on corroboration of those specific assertion types.
